summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the filing of a European patent application for novel psychedelic compounds to treat PTSD. The filing describes an exclusive worldwide licensing agreement with Yissum under which Clearmind holds global rights to develop, manufacture, and commercialize compounds. No deal terms, financial details, or special-situation corporate actions are disclosed. This is a routine intellectual property update by a foreign private issuer. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are referenced. The filing does not trigger any special-situation classification.
